rule: If the letter-action clean-relative minimum-minus-marker regret effect is <= -0.10, its paired-seed 95% upper limit is below zero, and all four seed effects are negative, select minimum_letter descendants; otherwise select the inherited principle-reflection descendants motivated by the replicated format and option-order effects.
fit: Class-mean differences for true optimal provider and independently for answer position; no intervention-based optimization.
references: Paired never-loyal checkpoints and unremediated parents; matched donor-to-parent rescue across changed option letters will distinguish semantic rescue from answer copying.
scope: One provider-versus-position hypothesis, not a broad layer sweep or a claim that a steering direction uniquely identifies the endogenous mechanism.
